neighbours.label: the degree word that sets up an indefinite article in the 'such a / too ADJ a / so ADJ a / as ADJ a' construction
fire: Running a bakery alone turned out to be such a tiring business that she sold it.

For a beginner, that was too steep a slope to try on the first day.

After the storm, nobody wanted to take such a risk on the open water.
